persona: Wedding & event photographers handling large shoots

accessNotes: Public marketing page; tool pricing and features change often, verify current terms before quoting a client.

persona: Photographers doing product, headshot, or portrait sessions

pricingNote: Free tier available; paid plans roughly $10-$20/month for batch or API use — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public tool page; confirm commercial usage rights and image-retention policy before uploading client photos.

persona: Portrait, headshot, and wedding photographers

workflowSummary: Import a batch of portraits; the AI detects each face and applies natural skin smoothing, blemish removal, and eye/teeth brightening consistently across the whole set.

persona: Wedding videographers, especially solo shooters and small studios

accessNotes: Newer/independent vendor; verify data-privacy and footage-storage terms before uploading client wedding footage.

persona: Photographers fulfilling print, canvas, or album orders

accessNotes: Public tool; confirm output resolution/format limits and commercial-use terms before selling prints made with it.

persona: Photographers delivering wedding, portrait, or event galleries

pricingNote: Free tiers with storage limits; paid plans roughly $8-$40/month, often commission-free on sales — verify before publishing

persona: Videographers producing social clips, wedding films, or event recaps

pricingNote: Free tiers with monthly minute limits; paid plans roughly $10-$30/month for more minutes/languages — verify before publishing

persona: Freelance and small-studio photographers

persona: Videographers shooting multi-camera weddings, events, or real estate video

persona: Photographers/videographers marketing their business on social media

persona: Wedding and event videographers

persona: Wedding and event videographers shooting in low-light venues

persona: Photographers offering restoration add-on services (family portraits, heirloom photos)
